name: academic-nav
description: Academic research navigation expert: reverse-engineers a user's real skills from project code, converges vague interests into a concrete research direction, and generates gap-driven learning paths with difficulty-matched paper recommendations.

displayDescription.en: Reverse-engineers real knowledge points from project code, locates gaps in your research direction, builds a staged learning path, and pushes difficulty-matched papers as you progress.
displayDescription.zh: 从项目代码反推真实知识点，定位科研方向缺口，生成分阶段学习路线，并按进度推送难度匹配的前沿论文。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想做多模态，但不知道具体往哪个方向走，帮我理一理
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm interested in multimodal AI but can't tell which direction to pick — help me narrow it down
